implementation: iStorage diskAshur2 and datAshur PRO2 Cryptographic Library
description: The iStorage diskAshur2 and datAshur PRO2 cryptographic library is a firmware library that provides cryptographic functions for the iStorage diskAshur2 and datAshur PRO2 ranges of PIN authenticated, hardware encrypted portable data storage devices. The cryptographic functions include AES-ECB-256, AES-CTR-256, SHA256, HMAC256, KWAE, KWAD and DRBG.
